title: Durable workspace authority reconciliation across daemon restart — runtime + E2E + lifecycle evidence

fix_summary.root_cause: resolve_status_authority numeric-key path depended on workspace_reconciliation_aliases.registry_workspace_id, an autoincrement id that drifts on every fresh daemon restart (144->156->158->161->170->175 observed). After drift the alias row was stale and workspace.status returned task_db_workspace_id=null.
fix_summary.fix: resolve_status_authority now records resolved_instance on both numeric-key and instance-key paths, then persistently cross-references the task-DB side via task_db_capture_by_instance + alias_by_instance (both keyed by the stable workspace_instance_id), immune to numeric id drift.

e2e_gate.mode: fresh client process against freshly restarted daemon (PID 3744)
final_run_checks: READ status(4baea3ff12c2ea5c) -> unified registry+task_db instance 4baea3ff12c2ea5c (registry_id=175, task_db_id=1)
WRITE task.create(1,ws-1) -> task T-1788389626135-c1c7fe34, exactly 1 workspace binding
NEG registry-only create(e193730e635b1ae1) -> fail-closed (no partial task row)
NEG stale registry id 144 + legacy instance ws-1 -> fail-closed (no partial rows)
MULTI TokenSlim instance (8f6a68ab29926f5f) cannot be task-bound (no cross-project bind)

lifecycle_proof.goal: new task must genuinely prove claim -> report -> persisted Reviewer verdict (task-show alone insufficient)
sequence: task.create with A' three-role role_contracts + identity_policy=legacy_identity_v1 (same params as CLI task create)
executor agent.register + task.claim (step S-1788389592440-e96d6b34) + task.report -> lifecycle review
reviewer agent.register (distinct instance/session, role independence enforced)
verdict.submit blind_first_pass/pass with authoritative new-schema role contract (rcl-...-reviewer rev 1)
persistence verified: row in task_verdict_events with verdict_id, phase, overall, snapshot_id, step_id
lifecycle_proof.snapshot_provenance: real workspace snapshot from registry.db row eb81cf5375f5446e (git remote git@github.com:nuoyazhizhou/callwarden.git, head 4ae1447b); verdict.submit requires non-empty snapshot_id and persists the caller-provided reference

governance_findings.finding: verdict.submit hard-requires non-empty snapshot_id; task.report accepts a caller-provided snapshot_id but bare task.create+claim+report leaves task_events.snapshot_id empty (no_snapshot), blocking verdicts unless the caller supplies a real workspace snapshot reference.

bare task.create RPC WITHOUT role_contracts+identity_policy produces a task with zero contracts (cannot be claimed by contract tasks' fail-closed gate). CLI task create always passes the A' three-role template; raw RPC callers must do the same.

role_contract_hash authority: when role_contract_lineages exist, the authoritative hash is role_contract_revisions.role_contract_hash; a legacy 17-field reconstructed payload hash fails E_ROLE_CONTRACT_HASH_MISMATCH.

forbidden_respected: no direct SQLite writes (all reads read-only; all writes via daemon RPC)
no identity/lease/binding forgery (identities registered via agent.register; lease acquired/released via lease.acquire/release)
no task.apply / task.close / task.supersede executed (probe task left in review_pending for adjudication path; remediation task handed to independent Reviewer)
